question: Which tab would you use to add a new slide to your MS PowerPoint presentation?
solution:
The correct answer is **4) Home.**

 
• The "Home" tab in PowerPoint contains the "New Slide" button, which is the primary way to add new slides to your presentation. 
 
• While the insert tab, allows you to insert many items into a power point presentation, the home tab is where the new slides are added.
